completeProcedure.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F; KEEP concentration up to one minute and raising, lowering or redirecting water. NEW select one actually perceived contiguous quantity of liquid water fitting at most a ten-foot cube, with initial line of effect, and record its real quantity/identity/contamination. Actual conjured water may qualify only while its own source permits this physical manipulation; preserve its original quantity, expiry, dispersal/consumption endings, recipient hydration limit and no-sale/no-ingredient restrictions. Manipulation never turns it into permanent natural stock. Fix a twenty-foot-cube working region with its center within sixty feet; all controlled water must remain in that region and within sixty feet of the caster when a new control operation is issued. Water inside a living body, a sealed vessel or a hostile worn/carried container is ineligible; another fluid, ice, steam or unselected incoming water is not silently converted into this inventory. At casting choose one initial operation; each later caster Action can issue one new operation. Each operation displaces the selected water at most ten feet along a declared actually open fluid path to available volume within the region. Choose Raise, Lower or Redirect: Raise lifts a supported connected body’s local surface by at most ten feet above its recorded starting level, maintaining that finite shape while concentration permits; Lower displaces its water sideways/down into actual available volume to lower the local surface at most ten feet below the starting level; Redirect changes its flow along the chosen open path, moving it at most ten feet for that operation. No cumulative height ratchet exceeds those bounds. Existing independent currents keep their actual behavior. There is no unlimited automatic conveyor after a single Action; without a new operation the magic only maintains the currently supported chosen shape. It can hold the selected finite water, not block an entire unselected river or create a vacuum that deletes incoming water. NEW a freely floating body/boat supported by the moved water follows its actual buoyancy and clearance; no weightless lift beyond its existing displacement/support or passage through a real anchor is created. When an operation would displace an unwilling swimming creature, it makes STR against spell DC: failure permits at most ten feet with that operation, success avoids that forced displacement if an actual reachable support/swimming position within its occupied water exists; absent any legal resisting position, the operation cannot force that creature through a barrier and stops at the last legal geometry. A free boat’s actual operating helmsman may instead make a DEX check with one genuinely applicable water-vehicle proficiency against spell DC, Core success/failure, for the whole boat; no fictional helmsman, control channel or repeated passenger saves. A moored/grounded/overloaded boat stays constrained by its real physical support; the spell supplies no breaking force. Each actual creature/boat can face at most one such forced-displacement attempt per Control Water family per round; additional Actions can move other water but cannot replay its forced-motion attempt. Willing following needs no roll. No hydraulic damage, whirlpool attack, automatic drowning, forced submerged airway, swimming speed or breathing benefit is supplied. Actual immersion, temperature, lost support, collisions and breath limits use their real rules and elapsed time. Controlled water keeps quantity and contamination; this is no creation, purification, fish harvest or free Supply. At loss of control, suppression or ending, the water obeys ordinary gravity/current from its actual present location; do not recreate it at its former source. Suppression lifts no fresh shape or missed motion when it ends: another legal Action is required to move/re-form the same remaining eligible water. Escaped water outside the region is no longer controlled; it is not replaced by new inflow. The current Fishing set has completed FI-E01–11 review. Its real stock, one deployment, fifty-five minutes to the check and five retrieval minutes remain; changing water access supplies no automatic catch or replacement roll. A worker spending this spell’s control Action cannot also credit that same six-second interval as active fishing work. Water movement never resets bait, opportunity, preservation or retrieval history.
